sources.claim: CISA and FBI cover WhisperGate and HermeticWiper in the same advisory on destructive malware deployed against Ukrainian organizations.
ESET identifies WhisperGate as a January 2022 Ukraine data wiper and HermeticWiper as a later high-profile Ukraine wiper campaign.
Microsoft documents WhisperGate as destructive malware against Ukrainian organizations in January 2022.

curator_note: Shared target/campaign ecosystem only. No code, actor, or direct lineage claim is implied.
confidence_reason: Public advisory and vendor reporting support common Ukraine destructive-malware context, but not a direct family relationship.
